text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is requesting approval to amend the existing parking regulations on Augusta Avenue, between Wales Avenue and Denison Square. This parking amendment will relocate the existing pay-and-display parking on the west side of Augusta Avenue, between Denison Square and Wales Avenue to the east side in order to enhance pedestrian safety fronting the Bellevue Square Park.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Rescinded the existing parking prohibition in effect at all times on the east side of Augusta Avenue, between Dundas Street West and a point opposite Wales Avenue. 2. Rescinded the existing parking prohibition in effect at all times on the east side of Augusta Avenue, between Dundas Street West and College Street. 3. Rescinded the existing stopping prohibition in effect at all times on the west side of Augusta Avenue, between Wales Avenue and a point 9 metres north. 4. Rescinded the existing stopping prohibition in effect at all times on the west side of Augusta Avenue, between Denison Square and a point 9 metres south. 5.
